newsitem.title: USA: US jet leaps on futures, ample supply hurts diffs.
newsitem.headline: US jet leaps on futures, ample supply hurts diffs.

text.p: U.S. cash jet fuel prices jumped as much as two cents a gallon on Wednesday tracking futures despite a weakening of differentials spurred by plentiful supplies in the Gulf Coast, traders said.
Gulf Coast aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was traded for a half cent over October futures, at least a half cent weaker than Tuesday diffs, players said.
"There's quite a bit of 54 around so it doesn't take a lot of sellers to bring it down," one broker said.
Traders said New York 54-grade material was offered at 4.0 cents over the print, 0.25 cent weaker than Tuesday.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
